notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: MacWall supplied NO app screenshots (macapp.supply gallery/shots empty; only cover.jpg + icon.png). Lineage/era are genuinely unknown (the 'native macOS app' claim is marketing copy, not evidence). All recorded tokens are BRAND/marketing readings, walled off from macOS canon and clusters. icon.png (scene-in-a-squircle: pale ground, red sun disc, dark mountain silhouette) is Workflow-B scope and was NOT icon-digested here. Category + cover metaphor strongly suggest a menu-bar / live-wallpaper utility — request the main gallery window, the menu-bar-extra, and settings before profiling.
